overridesJustification.babel-plugin-istanbul: Dependency hygiene, no longer a CVE workaround. @jest/transform 30.2.0 pins babel-plugin-istanbul ^7.0.1, whose test-exclude 6.x drags in the legacy glob 7 -> minimatch 3 -> brace-expansion 1.x branch. Forcing babel-plugin-istanbul 8 pairs it with test-exclude 7, keeping that whole branch out of the tree. This override originally worked around CVE-2026-14257 (GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg) when the brace-expansion 1.x line had no patched release; that is now fixed upstream in 1.1.18, which also covers CVE-2026-69152, so dropping the override would no longer expose a known CVE. It is retained because dropping it re-adds five superseded transitive packages (babel-plugin-istanbul 7, test-exclude 6, glob 7, minimatch 3, brace-expansion 1.x) that are recurring advisory targets. Safe to remove once @jest/transform depends on babel-plugin-istanbul ^8.
overridesJustification.@aws-sdk/util-dynamodb: Pin the compatible transitive version used by release 3.1.8. Later util-dynamodb 3.996.x releases require @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb ^3.1111.0, which conflicts with the requested 3.1094.0 SDK alignment. Remove after client-dynamodb and lib-dynamodb are upgraded to at least 3.1111.0.
